jasmandeep_singh999: Felix "Tin" Singh signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-F5 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
kamdensipple: Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple walked into S-F6 on Day 3 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could. Orders came through: Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a rosary of rough beads.
seamus_bj: The new sniper gave his name as Norbert Seamus. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
vis.acquillae: Edmund Acquillae left a teacher who said he would amount to nothing behind in Halden and came up the line with a stub of a pencil. The men noticed at once that he polishes his buttons every evening.
Volunteer number 34. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Edmund Acquillae's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
Edmund Acquillae asked to leave the riflemans and serve as a signaller. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.
Edmund Acquillae was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.

Edmund Acquillae taught Silas Zdsh to play the harmonica. The bay has asked them both, formally, to stop. Day 3: Verdel Ridge was lost. Edmund Acquillae wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
